name: IsFrameGenTypeAvailable
description: FRAME_GENERATION availability: 1 DLSS -> SlGetFeatureSupport()+0xF0, 3 XeSS -> g_XessFgAvailable 0x45C3EAA, 0 OFF / 2 FSR -> always true (no vendor or Wine check); 47 B; used by FrameGenSettingWrite

name: SetDlssFrameGenMultiplier
description: writes DLSS_FRAME_GEN_MULI 0x45BB00C = idx if IsDlssFrameGenMultiplierAvailable(idx) else 0

name: g_SlFeatureCaps
description: Streamline feature caps static returned by SlGetFeatureSupport 0x6B8E88 (thread-safe magic static): +0x10 Reflex, +0x20 DLSS SR, +0xF0 DLSS-G, +0x19C DLSS-G max multiplier

name: g_ConfigDirty
description: config changed by an options item (SetOptionValue sets 1); SaveConfigIfDirty 0x283892C writes config.xml and clears it; Nioh3EngineFix sets it after its FG switch (not for FG on under Proton)

name: SaveConfigIfDirty
description: if g_ConfigDirty: SaveConfig 0x1FE56A8, clear the flag; callers 0x2826F60 0x282729C 0x2827560 0x28276E4 (option screens)

name: SetOptionValue_FrameGenCase
description: option id 0x126 (Frame Generation) in SetOptionValue/CommitConfigValues 0x12A2368: FrameGenSettingWrite(value) then g_ConfigDirty=1

name: SetOptionValue_SetConfigDirty
description: C6 05 CC 28 32 03 01; shared tail of SetOptionValue cases

name: CommitConfigValues
description: role confirmed: per-item options setter (switch on the menu item id; 0x126 = FRAME_GENERATION via FrameGenSettingWrite; sets g_ConfigDirty)

name: DisplaySettingsWatcher
description: per frame (from 0x12399D0): compares DISP_MODE/MONITOR/SCR_REZ/HDR/FRAME_GENERATION to w+0x1B0..0x1C4 and posts 0x403/0x402/0x401/0x404/0x405 (FG) to the game window; applies VSYNC/SHADOW_QUAL directly; counts w+0x13C down and runs DisplayResetRebuildSwapchain when w+0x138 is set and [0x475A420]+0x248/0x249 are clear

name: DisplaySettingsWatcher_FrameGenCompare
description: FG slot vs cached w+0x1C4 -> PostMessage 0x405

name: DisplayResetRebuildSwapchain
signature: bool DisplayResetRebuildSwapchain(void* p1, int* desc, Gfx* g)
description: waits for 0x3B2970 idle (Sleep(1)), builds the swapchain desc (VSYNC, 3 buffers, refresh change flag, FG backend ptr by FRAME_GENERATION: DLSS 0x198D150 / FSR 0x34692B4 / XeSS 0x3420C98) and calls RecreateSwapchainDevice 0x2EEA690; callers 0x1350210, 0x1351690

name: RecreateSwapchainDevice
signature: bool RecreateSwapchainDevice(GfxDevice* d, Desc* desc, void* modes)

name: ApplyGraphicsSettings_StoreFgPauseFlag
